indicator_name: Degree of wear of tangible fixed assets, end of year
description: Степень износа основных средств на конец года
methodology: Percent, degree of wear, % (accumulated depreciation / gross stock). Tangible fixed assets («Основные средства», Taldau term 455728, intangibles excluded) of all enterprises, form 11, national, from 2000. Historical-cost book values incl. revaluations -- not a volume measure. Taldau 703216.
